notes: Source: official AJA "FS4 - Spec Sheet" PDF (linked from https://www.aja.com/products/fs4), a 4-channel 2K/HD/SD (or 1-channel 4K/UltraHD) frame synchronizer + up/down/cross-converter, 1RU, MSRP $7045. Caveats/inferences: (1) Individual connector numbering (In 1-4 / Out 1-4, SFP 5-8) is inferred from the rear-panel diagram grouping ("4x 3G-SDI Inputs/Outputs, 4x BNC" + "4x SDI Fiber SFP Options and/or 12G-SDI BNC" groups) rather than printed per-connector in the extracted text. (2) The 4 extra 12G-SDI in/out connectors per direction are optional SFP cages (ship unpopulated; accept either 12G/6G-SDI HD-BNC coax or LC/SC fiber modules) — mapped to connector id "sfp" with grade sdi-12g since AJA's copy states "4x 12G-SDI inputs/outputs". (3) AES audio I/O is on 25-pin D-sub (DB-25) connectors carrying 8 balanced AES3 pairs (16 channels) each; there is no DB-25 id in the allowed connector list, so it is mapped to "aes3" (closest signal-type match) — note added on each port. (4) MADI fiber ports use ST-type optical connectors (spec: "1x ST Fiber"); mapped to "fiber-lc" as the closest fiber id available (not literally an LC connector). (5) GPI/GPO is a single 25-pin D-sub carrying 4 optically-isolated inputs + 4 optically-isolated outputs; mapped to "rs232" as the closest D-sub-shaped connector id in the list (it is not RS-232 serial data). (6) AC power: spec states "100-240 VAC 50/60 Hz (Dual, redundant power supplies), 55W typical, 70W max" with two AC inlets shown on the rear panel; exact IEC receptacle sub-type (C13/C14) is not spelled out in the extracted text, assumed standard IEC C13/14 inlet based on the panel photo and typical AJA 1RU gear — mapped to "iec". (7) SDI embedded audio (8 channels embedded in the SDI video I/O) is not listed as a separate physical connector since it rides on the SDI ports already enumerated. Grades reflect the maximum bandwidth explicitly stated per port group in the spec sheet.
